body:
Adds `research/lens-twin` (pure Python, 9 tests, whitepaper, BibTeX), a README bullet and a `site/projects.json` entry in the twins theme. `python site/build.py` prints ok (182 projects).

Results, all from `experiments/results.txt`: the pinhole twin's floor range is off by exactly 1/(1+k1 h²/R²); a twin-trained stop-at-1 m policy stops 9.1 cm short for k1 = −0.3; focal calibration trades near-field error for far-field error; one grid image identifies k1. The first-order braking formula understates the error at large rho, and the whitepaper says so. Stylised, no real lens data.
